items.title: How much does org-level leverage scale with adoption?
items.description: Marcus's own team's share of the duplicate-charge problem is about $4,444/month. If he only fixes Payments, that's the ceiling — bounded by his own team, no matter how good the fix is. Drag the number of teams adopting his shared retry library (out of 6 teams in the org) and watch the monthly cost avoided scale past what any single team's fix could reach. Conformance models how faithfully each adopting team actually implements the shared library rather than a partial version of it.
items.compute: const perTeamMonthly = 4444; const avoided = params.teamsAdopting * perTeamMonthly * (params.conformanceRate / 100); return { costAvoided: avoided };
